mike_g: Quick operational Q recruiter pushed an offer with L5 title for an external candidate but hiring manager submitted L4 in Workday. Recruiter asks to fast-align title on day one. What do we need to avoid payroll issues?

tara_b: checklist: market comp snapshot, hiring manager justification (1-2 lines), director ack, HRBP note, comp partner sign-off if comp or level bump.

sam.payroll: FYI payroll cutoff is 2026-04-10 17:00 PT for the next cycle. Anything submitted after that moves to next cycle.

mike_g: if candidate starts before cutoff and we finalize after, is retro pay automatic?

sam.payroll: retro pay processed in next 2 cycles after approval. Need fully signed evidence + effective date. If late, expect delay.

tara_b: also: title in offer can be "subject to final Workday title" but internal consistency rules mean we should aim to match Workday on first paycheck. If can't, delay start or onboard as contractor.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: Promotion & External Hire policy v3.0 requires comp partner approval for >10% comp variance and two independent reviewer signoffs for cross-org level moves. See policy link in Confluence.

mike_g: recruiter wants a one-line note to send candidate now. Can someone draft 2 sentences?

tara_b: draft: "We're excited to move forward. Final title and compensation will be confirmed in Workday prior to your first paycheck; if anything needs adjustment it will be handled via a documented onboarding change and any retro pay will be processed once approvals are complete."

mike_g: perfect. I'll send. tagging @people-ops-bot to log this thread.

people-ops-bot: Logged. Action: attach fast-track checklist to case if requesting expedited review.
